itemName: The Ordinary - Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Serum (30 ml)
description: A lightweight, water-based serum formulated with 10% niacinamide (vitamin B3) and 1% zinc PCA. It targets large pores, excess oil, and uneven texture, boosting skin radiance while supporting barrier integrity. Especially effective for blemish-prone and oily skin. Clinical use has shown visible smoothing within a week.

itemName: CeraVe - Moisturizing Cream with Ceramides & Hyaluronic Acid (340 g)
description: A rich yet non-greasy moisturizer packed with three essential ceramides, hyaluronic acid, petrolatum, and dimethicone. It uses patented MVE™ delivery to continuously release hydration, helping to restore and maintain the skin’s protective barrier. Ideal for dry to very dry skin on both face and body. Dermatologist-developed, fragrance-free, hypoallergenic and well-liked by sensitive-skin users.

itemName: La Roche‑Posay - Anthelios UV Clear Sunscreen SPF 50 (50 ml)
description: A dermatologist-approved, broad-spectrum sunscreen featuring Cell-Ox Shield® technology. It’s lightweight, fast-absorbing, and formulated with azelaic acid to help calm sensitive, acne- or rosacea-prone skin. It’s non-comedogenic, invisible on the skin, and provides immediate and long-lasting hydration without a white cast.

itemName: The Ordinary - Squalane Cleanser (30 ml / 1.7 oz)
description: A gentle balm-to-oil cleanser formulated with plant-derived squalane and lipophilic esters that effectively dissolve makeup, sunscreen, and impurities. It cleanses without stripping the skin’s natural oils, supporting your skin barrier and leaving a smooth, hydrated feel. Ideal for all skin types, including sensitive and dry. Users say it "melts into an oil" and leaves skin "smooth and hydrated afterward" .

itemName: CeraVe - Hydrating Facial Cleanser (355 ml / 12 fl oz)
description: A creamy, non-foaming cleanser formulated with three essential ceramides, hyaluronic acid, and MVE® technology to gently cleanse while maintaining the skin’s moisture barrier. It removes dirt, oil, and light makeup without leaving skin tight or dry—making it ideal for normal to dry and sensitive skin. Dermatologists confirm it’s effective and soothing .

itemName: La Roche‑Posay - Toleriane Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser (400 ml)
description: A mild, creamy face wash with ceramide‑3, niacinamide, glycerin, and La Roche‑Posay Thermal Spring Water. It gently cleanses away impurities and makeup while reinforcing the skin barrier and delivering sustained hydration. Non-comedogenic, fragrance‑free, and suitable for dry/sensitive skin. Reviews highlight its gentle yet effective cleansing, especially as a second cleanse or morning wash .

itemName: The Ordinary - Salicylic Acid 2% Masque (50 ml)
description: A clarifying clay and charcoal mask with 2% salicylic acid—a lipophilic BHA known for penetrating pores. It deeply exfoliates, purges impurities, combats dullness, and refines texture. Kaolin clay and charcoal work together to absorb excess oil. Use it once or twice weekly for smoother, more radiant skin without over-drying.

itemName: The Ordinary - Caffeine Solution 5% + EGCG - Brightening Eye Serum (30 ml)
description: A high-potency, water-based serum combining 5% caffeine and green tea-derived EGCG to visibly reduce under-eye puffiness and dark circles. Lightweight and gentle, it’s ideal for morning routines and prepping the eye area for makeup.

itemName: The Ordinary – Natural Moisturizing Factors + Inulin Body Lotion (240 ml)
description: Lightweight, non-greasy lotion packed with skin-identical natural moisturizing factors like amino acids, urea, PCA, and the prebiotic inulin. Delivers instant and long-lasting hydration, helps restore the protective skin barrier, and prevents dryness post-shower.

itemName: CeraVe – SA Body Wash for Rough & Bumpy Skin (296 ml / 10 oz)
description: A gentle, preservative-free body wash containing salicylic acid for chemical exfoliation and ceramides plus hyaluronic acid for hydration. Designed to improve texture and smooth rough, bumpy skin safely without abrasive particles.

itemName: La Roche-Posay – Lipikar AP+ Gentle Cleansing Oil (400 ml)
description: A lipid-replenishing, soap-free cleansing oil enriched with shea butter, niacinamide (Vitamin B3), and La Roche-Posay’s Thermal Spring Water. It hydrates, restores the skin barrier, and relieves itching or irritation without leaving a greasy residue. Can be used directly on damp skin in the shower or bath and also as a soothing post-bath treatment.

A gentle, tear-free shampoo and body wash developed with pediatric dermatologists. Though marketed for babies, it's loved by adults with sensitive scalps. Formulated with ceramides and hyaluronic acid to maintain scalp moisture and barrier health.

itemName: The Ordinary - Behentrimonium Chloride 2% Conditioner (240 ml)
description: A minimalist, no-fragrance conditioner with 2% behentrimonium chloride that smooths hair, reduces frizz, and improves manageability. Free from oils, silicones, or heavy waxes. Lightweight and ideal for all hair types.

itemName: La Roche-Posay - Kerium Intensive Hair Mask (200 ml)
description: A soothing hair mask formulated for sensitive scalps and damaged hair. Infused with La Roche-Posay Thermal Spring Water and vitamin B5 to calm the scalp and nourish fragile strands. Lightweight but intensely hydrating.

itemName: The Ordinary - Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA for Scalp (60 ml)
description: This is a water-light, hydrating scalp serum/oil hybrid that supports scalp barrier health. With natural moisturizing factors and hyaluronic acid, it improves scalp hydration—promoting healthy hair growth from the root.
